description: I1 probe for cor:knot-factor-borromean-composite.  Verifies the Brunnian-decoupling structural claim for k=2 (⁴He as Bor_2): χ_λ(β_Bor_2) = χ_λ(β_{4_1})² for each λ ⊢ 3.  Uses the single-component 4_1 characters verified by the BD probe in PR #815.  Records the per-block expected products.  Note: the explicit formula (1 − h²)^k from the old corollary statement is moot under the revised Markov-amphicheirality framework (PR #817), but the underlying decoupling claim — that disjoint Brunnian components give multiplicative characters — remains structurally valid and is the content this probe witnesses.

cascade_note.revised_formula: a_Bor_k = (a_{4_1})^k where a_{4_1} = Σ_λ w_λ · (χ_λ(β_{4_1})/χ_λ(𝟏))²  [from cor:knot-factor-amphicheiral, PR #817]
cascade_note.structural_invariant: Brunnian decoupling χ_λ(β_Bor_k) = ∏_i χ_λ(β_{4_1}^(i)) is independent of the amphicheiral-corollary form; this probe witnesses the decoupling alone.
